Define a zone

Source: R/zones.R
zone.Rd

A zone holds every rule that applies to sites in it. zone() defines a full zone for add_zone(); zone_changes() takes the same arguments, all optional, and describes only what a precinct, overlay or scenario changes.

Usage

zone(
  key,
  label = NULL,
  method = c("volumetric", "density", "hybrid", "none"),
  height = NULL,
  setbacks = list(),
  coverage = NULL,
  landscaping = NULL,
  impervious = NULL,
  paved = NULL,
  far = NULL,
  deep_soil = NULL,
  form = NULL,
  density = NULL,
  use = NULL,
  storey_height = NULL,
  ground_floor_height = NULL,
  variants = NULL,
  source = NULL,
  notes = NULL
)

zone_changes(...)

Arguments

key

Short identifier, used everywhere else in the rulebook.

label

Human-readable name.

method

How capacity is estimated: "volumetric" (build the storey envelope), "density" (read dwellings straight off a density rule), "hybrid" (both; the lesser wins) or "none" (the zone carries no capacity but is kept so rules that depend on neighbouring zones can see it, e.g. open space).

height

A height_limit().

setbacks

A list of setbacks from yard(), plane(), upper_level_setback(), proportional_setback() or setback_profile().

coverage, landscaping, impervious, paved, far, deep_soil

Site ratio rules: maximum building coverage, minimum landscaped area, maximum impervious area, maximum paved area, maximum floor area ratio, minimum deep soil. Each a number, a formula string or a ratio().

form

Building form limits, from building_form().

density

Density rules, from density().

use

Uses enabled and the residential share, from use_mix().

storey_height, ground_floor_height

Storey heights (m). Default from the rulebook defaults.

variants

Named list describing alternative standards; each element a list with label and source. Rules are tied to a variant with their own variant argument.

source

Citation for the zone.

notes

Free text.

...

For zone_changes(): any arguments of zone() except key, plus replaces_setbacks: the setback kinds ("yard", "plane", "upper_level", "proportional", "profile") whose rules the change's setbacks replace. The zone's setbacks of other kinds are kept. Defaults to the kinds that appear in the change's setbacks; give it with an empty setbacks list to remove every rule of a kind (e.g. a precinct with no recession plane).

Value

A list with class plancap_zone.

Details

Lengths are in the rulebook's units (metres unless the rulebook says feet).

See also

add_zone()

Examples

zone("MRZ", "Medium Density Residential",
  height = height_limit(11, roof_allowance = 1, storeys = 3, source = "MRZ-S1"),
  setbacks = list(
    yard(1.5, "road", source = "MRZ-S4"),
    yard(1, c("side", "rear"), source = "MRZ-S4"),
    plane(60, start_height = 4, boundaries = c("side", "rear"), source = "MRZ-S3")
  ),
  coverage = ratio(0.5, source = "MRZ-S5"),
  landscaping = ratio(0.2, source = "MRZ-S6"))

#> [1] "Medium Density Residential"
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "volumetric"
#> 
#> $height
#> $height$value

#>

#> [1] 10
#>

#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $height$source
#> [1] "MRZ-S1"
#> 
#>

#> [1] "yard"

#> $setbacks[[3]]$boundaries

#>
